_help: Edit the 'text' of any line to change what the caller hears. To use YOUR OWN VOICE instead of the computer voice, record the line, save it as an MP3 in public/audio/ using the file name shown in 'audio', and it will be played automatically. Missing audio files fall back to the computer voice reading 'text'. 'questions' are asked one by one after the caller picks a service: add, remove or reorder them freely ('label' is the short name shown in your dashboard, 'maxSeconds' is how long they can answer). See VOICE-SCRIPT.md.

greeting.text: Hello! This is a call from Selfie TV Boss Entertainment. We see you're promoting an upcoming show or event, and we'd love to help make it a big success. Selfie TV Boss is a professional event host, D J, entertainer, movie actor, project manager and promoter.

inboundGreeting.text: Thank you for calling Selfie TV Boss Entertainment, the host that makes your event go live!

menu.text: For project managing, press 1. For hosting your show or event, press 2. For D J services, press 3. For entertainment, press 4. For movie acting and on-camera work, press 5. For promotions, press 6. To speak with Selfie TV Boss now, press 0. To hear these options again, press star. If you would rather not get calls from us, press 9.

noInput.text: Sorry, we didn't get a choice.

invalid.text: Sorry, that's not one of the options.

questionsIntro.text: We just have a few quick questions so Selfie TV Boss can get back to you with the right package. Answer each one after the beep, then press the pound key.

thanks.text: Thank you! Selfie TV Boss will call you back very soon. You can also book online at selfie T V boss dot com. Have a great day!

connecting.text: Please hold while we connect you to Selfie TV Boss.

ownerUnavailable.text: Selfie TV Boss can't take the call right now, but he'll call you right back.

optOut.text: You have been removed from our call list and won't receive any more calls from us. Sorry to bother you, and have a great day.

goodbye.text: Thanks for your time. To book Selfie TV Boss, visit selfie T V boss dot com. Goodbye!

voicemail.text: Hi, this is Selfie TV Boss Entertainment. We'd love to help with your upcoming show or event, whether you need a host, a D J, an entertainer, promotions or full project management. Call us back at this number, or book online at selfie T V boss dot com. Thanks!

options.text: Great choice! Selfie TV Boss can manage your whole event, from planning and vendors to timelines and the run of show.
Excellent! Selfie TV Boss brings high energy hosting to shows, parties, launches, pageants and award nights.
Let's turn it up! Selfie TV Boss can D J your event and keep the crowd moving all night.
Wonderful! Selfie TV Boss brings comedy, crowd games and interactive entertainment that keeps everybody engaged.

Let's get your event seen! Selfie TV Boss can promote your show on camera, on social media and live on the scene.

questions.label: Name
questions.text: First, what's your name, and the name of your company or promotion?

questions.label: Event & date
questions.text: What's the name of your event, and what date is it?

questions.label: Other details
questions.text: Last one. Tell us anything else we should know, like the expected crowd size, your budget, or the best time to call you back.
